note: The Type I error depends on the prior of the constant hazard models, which the article does not report. With the prior of the main simulation (placebo incidence of the log-logistic distribution at week 52, 5.0%, df = 2) it is 0 for EXP_BERN and BDRIBS(2). With the prior from the placebo incidence of 4% at week 104 stated in Section 4.2.1 it is about 0.18 for both models, close to Figure 5 (about 0.19), and the criterion holds (items D_PRIOR_5_P1_EXP_BERN_power, D_PRIOR_5_P1_BDRIBS2_power and D_PRIOR_Q_F5a of reproduce_Duncan2026_prior.R). The published overestimation (about 0.025) lies between the two, so the direction of the statement is reproduced but its size is not (items D_PRIOR_6_*_rd).
